# MakeHuman base mesh (CC0)

`mh_data.npz` packs the MakeHuman hm08 base mesh, its default skeleton and skin weights, and the
morph targets `lib_anime/mh_base.py` shapes heroes with. MakeHuman released these core assets
under CC0 1.0 (public domain) in 2020: https://static.makehumancommunity.org/about/license.html
(copyright holders at release: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier). No attribution
is required; this note records the source.

Rebuild with `python extract.py <dir>` from the four source files listed in `extract.py`.
